requirements.statement: A merchant can sign up and provide basic business details

criteria.must: A new merchant can submit business name, email, phone and country to register
A registered merchant's currency is derived from their registered country

requirements.statement: A merchant can sign in securely so only they can manage their account and see their transactions

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user cannot access the merchant dashboard or its data
A signed-in merchant sees only their own account data, not another merchant's

requirements.statement: A merchant can create a payment request (a payment page/link) for a sale amount to send to a customer

criteria.must: A signed-in merchant can create a payment request by specifying a sale amount
Creating a payment request produces a shareable payment link

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment request via mobile money without creating an account

criteria.must: Opening a payment link does not require the customer to sign in or create an account
A customer can complete payment of a payment request using mobile money

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment request via card

criteria.must: A customer can complete payment of a payment request using a debit/credit card

requirements.statement: A customer sees a clear confirmation once their payment succeeds

criteria.must: After a successful payment, the customer is shown an on-screen success confirmation
The confirmation is clear and understandable to a non-technical customer

requirements.statement: A merchant is notified in-app when a payment is received, so they know to fulfill the order

criteria.must: When a payment request is successfully paid, the merchant sees an in-app notification of the received payment

requirements.statement: A merchant can view a history of all their transactions with status (pending, successful, failed)

criteria.must: A signed-in merchant can view a list of their transactions
Each listed transaction shows its status as pending, successful, or failed

requirements.statement: A merchant can see their available balance to know how much they can withdraw

criteria.must: A signed-in merchant can view their current available balance

requirements.statement: A merchant can request a payout of their available balance to their own bank account or mobile money wallet

criteria.must: A signed-in merchant can submit a payout request specifying an amount and a destination
A merchant can choose either a bank account or a mobile money wallet as the payout destination

requirements.statement: A merchant can see the status of their payout requests to know when their money has been sent

criteria.must: A signed-in merchant can view a list of their payout requests with their status
